scope: Read-only verification of saved update responses and separate full native issue get readbacks. Original source prefix is byte-exact; normalization applies ONLY to newly appended proposed text.
metadataPolicy: Every actually observed original metadata field remains exactly equal, including labels, status/hold, parent, relations, milestones, priorities, reported assignees/estimates, releases, identifiers and lifecycle fields. Only updatedAt and explicit appended description-only state-history events may change. Unreported assignee/estimate values are not invented as null facts.
appendResponseLimitation: Update responses omit relation/release/history fields; they do not substitute for independent final full get readbacks.

normalizationPolicyForNewAppendOnly.criterion: Only terminal LF characters may be omitted by the native rich-text readback. Interior newlines, spaces and all text remain exact.
Only complete pipe-table separator lines with cells consisting solely of two or three dashes (optional alignment colons) may use two dashes. Cell count, spaces, pipes and alignment are retained.
Only angle wrappers around an HTTP(S) Markdown link destination are removed. Link label and every destination character remain exact.
Only the two exact preverified native PR tag tuples below map to the same bare #173/#184 reference. Unknown IDs, names, numbers, attributes or targets remain unchanged and fail equality.
Only the exact source citation [#173](https://github.com/nakul175/saha-health/pull/173) maps to the same preverified native #173 identity; other URLs and citation labels are not removed.

Only a single native blank line between an exact **CWO-ID** — proposed fixture `PROP-CWO-ID`; actor paragraph and its first * Given: list may differ, with matching CWO/fixture IDs. This is permitted solely in new proposed addenda, never in retained original descriptions or criterion clauses.

Only new-addendum <issue> references whose UUID and visible APL identifier equal a retained actual source record, and whose HTTPS Linear workspace/issue identifier equals that source record, map to the same bare APL identifier. The title slug is presentation. Unknown attributes, UUIDs, labels, hosts, identifiers, queries or fragments remain unchanged and fail equality.

Only the single terminal space on the exact new-addendum line "* Reviewable output: Reviewable implementation or individually verified reuse demonstrating the preserved outcome: " may be omitted by native rich text. The empty proposed summary is recorded separately as an editorial gap; no outcome is invented and original source text is never normalized.
